## What did you try? / 试用了哪个入口？

- [ ] Three-decision invoice example / 三次决策的发票案例
- [ ] Optional pandas/CSV example / pandas 与 CSV 案例
- [ ] Snapshot or rolling report / 快照或滚动报告
- [ ] Adapted a small synthetic dataset / 换成自己的小份合成数据

## Environment and command / 环境与命令

Python version, operating system, commit or release, and the command you ran.
If using the CSV example, also include your pandas version.

## Expected and observed selection / 预期与实际结果

Which record, value or missingness status did you expect, and what did you get?
For a different temporal result, include a minimal synthetic example with the
event, publication, ingestion and decision times.

## What would make this easier to use? / 哪一步需要改善？

Mention a confusing instruction, missing adapter, or useful counterexample.
